title: 115 people vanished. They left one word. 🪓 #shorts
description: True story: in 1590, John White returned to the Roanoke colony. Everyone was gone. Only one word was carved on a post: CROATOAN. #shorts #truestory #unsolvedmystery #roanoke #hollowmere

beats.en: True story. 1590. A governor returns to his colony after three years.
beats.es: Historia real. 1590. Un gobernador vuelve a su colonia tras tres años.
beats.de: Wahre Geschichte. 1590. Ein Gouverneur kehrt nach drei Jahren zu seiner Kolonie zurück.
beats.fr: Histoire vraie. 1590. Un gouverneur revient dans sa colonie après trois ans.
beats.it: Storia vera. 1590. Un governatore torna alla sua colonia dopo tre anni.
beats.pt: História real. 1590. Um governador volta à sua colônia depois de três anos.

beats.en: About a hundred and fifteen people are gone. No sign of a fight.
beats.es: Unas ciento quince personas han desaparecido. Ni rastro de lucha.
beats.de: Etwa hundertfünfzehn Menschen sind fort. Keine Spur eines Kampfes.
beats.fr: Environ cent quinze personnes ont disparu. Aucune trace de combat.
beats.it: Circa centoquindici persone sono sparite. Nessun segno di lotta.
beats.pt: Cerca de cento e quinze pessoas sumiram. Nenhum sinal de luta.

beats.en: Only one word, carved into a post: CROATOAN.
beats.es: Solo una palabra, tallada en un poste: CROATOAN.
beats.de: Nur ein Wort, in einen Pfosten geschnitzt: CROATOAN.
beats.fr: Un seul mot, gravé dans un poteau : CROATOAN.
beats.it: Solo una parola, incisa su un palo: CROATOAN.
beats.pt: Só uma palavra, entalhada num poste: CROATOAN.

beats.es: Nunca se les volvió a ver.
